post.summary: Generate reinvestment proposals for explicit client×product targets
post.description:
Generate one reinvestment proposal per (client_id, source_product_id) pair.

### Request body

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `reinvestment_targets` | array (required) | List of `{client_id, source_product_id}` pairs. Each pair produces one proposal. |
| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `max_candidates_per_product_type` | int (1–10) | Diversification cap on how many candidate products are kept per product type. Default `2`. |
| `max_candidates_per_client` | int (1–50) | Max candidate products passed to the LLM per client. Default `10`. |
| `risk_rating_hard_filter` | bool | When `true`, only products with `risk_rating <= client.risk_rating` are considered. Default `true`. |
| `response_mode` | enum | How the proposal is returned in the response:
- `path` — return only the output file path.
- `markdown` — return only the proposal markdown.
- `both` — return the path **and** the markdown. Default `path`. |
| `include_llm_input` | bool | Include the assembled LLM prompt in the response. Default `false`. |
| `include_market_outlook` | bool | Include the market outlook section. Default `true`. |
| `include_debug_scores` | bool | Include debug scoring details. Default `false`. |

### Example

```json
{
  "reinvestment_targets": [
    {"client_id": "PB-HK-000007-5", "source_product_id": "PROD053"}
  ],
  "max_candidates_per_product_type": 2,
  "max_candidates_per_client": 10,
  "risk_rating_hard_filter": true,
  "response_mode": "both",
  "include_debug_scores": false
}
```

AutomatchRequest.title: AutomatchRequest
AutomatchRequest.description:
Batch product opportunity proposal via product-investor matching.

Example payload::

    {
      "product_source": "default_yaml",
      "product_ids": ["bank_recommended"],
      "client_selection": {"risk_rating": [1, 5]},
      "run_matcher": true,
      "max_proposals": 2
    }

When *product_source* is ``default_yaml``, *product_ids* may contain
group names defined in ``config_planbot.yaml`` under ``product_groups``
(expanded to their member product IDs).  When *product_source* is
``request_payload``, *product_ids* are always literal product IDs.
